tools.name: run
tools.description: Turns one JSON payload into a complete RFC 5545 .ics file — recurrence (RRULE), real IANA time zones with generated VTIMEZONE blocks, reminders (VALARM), organizer and multiple attendees — and returns the matching Google, Outlook, Office 365 and Yahoo add-to-calendar links in the same response, wher

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "run" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
